svg.title: Week 19 · Team practical · four stations
svg.desc: A: API checks and fields · 30 min · 25 marks; B: memory safety and input checks · 35 min · 25 marks; C: trusted signed file and least privilege · 30 min · 25 marks; D: AI output and deny on error · 35 min · 25 marks. 130 minutes on stations + 20 for instructions and submission; 100 Technical marks = 15 course points; no project questions during the exam.
